cases.title: Resize Large Images to Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that images larger than the viewport dimensions are automatically resized to fit within the browser window.

cases.title: Restore Image to Original Size
cases.description: Verify that a resized image can be toggled or restored back to its original dimensions.

cases.title: Save Image via Context Menu
cases.description: Verify that right-clicking an image provides an option to save the image to the local drive and completes successfully.

cases.title: Set Image as Wallpaper
cases.description: Verify that an image can be set as the desktop wallpaper through the browser interface.

cases.title: Print Image Without Modifying Page State
cases.description: Verify that triggering a print action for an image prints it successfully without altering the currently loaded page state.

cases.title: Image Redithering on System Bit-Depth Changes
cases.description: Verify that images are properly redithered when the operating system's bit-depth settings are modified.

cases.title: Display Modified Images on Page Reload
cases.description: Verify that reloading a web page correctly fetches and displays images that have been modified on the server since the last load.

cases.title: Load Images from Networked Server
cases.description: Verify that images load directly into the web browser from a remote networked server via standard protocols.

cases.title: Load Images from Local Hard Drive
cases.description: Verify that images load directly into the web browser from a local storage path.

cases.title: Continuous Animation of GIFs Over Extended Periods
cases.description: Verify that animated GIFs continue to animate correctly and do not freeze or leak memory after 24 hours or greater.

cases.title: Simultaneous Rendering of Multiple Differing Animated GIFs
cases.description: Verify that multiple unique animated images displayed on the same page animate concurrently and correctly.

cases.title: Render GIF 87 Images Across Bit Depths
cases.description: Verify that GIF 87 format images are properly displayed across various system bit depths.

cases.title: Render GIF 89a Images Across Bit Depths
cases.description: Verify that GIF 89a format images are properly displayed across various system bit depths.

cases.title: Graceful Handling of Corrupted or Invalid GIFs
cases.description: Verify that the web browser handles unusual, corrupted, or invalid GIF images gracefully without crashing or freezing.

cases.title: Display X Bitmap (XBM) Format Images
cases.description: Verify that X Bitmap (XBM) format images are parsed and displayed correctly.

cases.title: Execute Applets Within Tag Elements
cases.description: Verify that applets are correctly executed when embedded using <applet> and <object> tags.

cases.title: Manage Applet Lifecycle
cases.description: Verify that applets correctly execute lifecycle events such as initialization, starting, stopping, and destruction.

opinions.feedback: All high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, cover the requirements comprehensively, and are actionable. No blockers were found.
All cases and expected behaviors align with the requirements and are testable.

analysis.analysis:
R-085: Testable behavior includes shrinking images larger than viewport dimensions to fit the browser window. Boundaries: image dimensions exactly equal to, smaller than, and larger than viewport. Normal path: large image automatically fits window. Abnormal path: image overflows viewport. Ambiguity: definition of 'large image' (dimensions vs file size).
R-086: Testable behavior includes toggling resized image back to original dimensions. Normal path: click or trigger resize-to-original on a resized image. Abnormal path: attempting resize on non-resizable image. Ambiguity: exact UI mechanism for restoring original size.
R-087: Testable behavior includes saving image via context menu. Normal path: right-click image, select save option, verify file saved to local drive. Abnormal path: right-click on non-image elements, network interruption during save.
R-088: Testable behavior includes setting an image as desktop wallpaper. Normal path: select set-as-wallpaper option, verify OS wallpaper updates. Abnormal path: insufficient OS permissions. Ambiguity: supported OS environments.
R-089: Testable behavior includes printing an image without altering the current page state. Normal path: trigger print, verify page remains unchanged. Abnormal path: print failure. Ambiguity: printing behavior when loaded as standalone image vs embedded image.
R-090: Testable behavior includes updating image dithering when system bit depth changes. Normal path: change OS bit depth, verify image re-dithers correctly. Abnormal path: unsupported bit depths. Ambiguity: acceptable visual thresholds for proper re-dithering.
R-091: Testable behavior includes fetching and displaying modified images on page reload. Normal path: modify remote image, reload page, verify updated image displays. Abnormal path: caching prevents update. Ambiguity: cache invalidation mechanism.
R-092: Testable behavior includes loading images from networked servers. Normal path: load image via http/https. Abnormal path: 404, timeout, network failure.
R-093: Testable behavior includes loading images from local storage (file://). Normal path: load local file path. Abnormal path: permission denied, non-existent file.
R-094: Testable behavior includes continuous animation of GIFs over >= 24 hours. Normal path: leave animated GIF running for 24+ hours. Abnormal path: memory leaks or frozen frames.
R-095: Testable behavior includes simultaneous rendering of multiple unique animated images. Normal path: page with multiple differing animated GIFs. Abnormal path: high CPU usage, frame dropping, one animation freezing another.
R-096: Testable behavior includes rendering GIF 87 images across various bit depths. Normal path: display GIF 87 at 8-bit, 16-bit, 24-bit, 32-bit.
R-097: Testable behavior includes rendering GIF 89a images across various bit depths. Normal path: display GIF 89a at 8-bit, 16-bit, 24-bit, 32-bit.
R-098: Testable behavior includes error handling for corrupted/invalid GIFs. Normal path: load malformed GIF. Abnormal path: browser crash or infinite loop. Ambiguity: definition of 'gracefully deal' (placeholder icon vs blank space vs throwing error).
R-099: Testable behavior includes parsing and rendering XBM format images. Normal path: load valid XBM file. Abnormal path: malformed XBM syntax.
R-100: Testable behavior includes executing applets within <applet> and <object> tags. Normal path: render valid applet tags. Abnormal path: missing plugin, malformed tags.
R-101: Testable behavior includes managing applet lifecycle events (init, start, stop, destroy). Normal path: load, navigate away from, and reload page containing applets. Abnormal path: memory leaks during destroy phase.
